lines: Washing more can mean more breakouts.
Washing several times a day irritates skin. Twice a day is enough.
Only teens get acne? Myth. Adults can get it into their fifties.
Tanning dries out pimples? Myth. Tanning can make acne worse.
Dab it only on the pimple? Myth. Cover the whole area.
Makeup causes acne? Half true. Sleeping in it can.
